ledgerchest_piece_desc: An iron-bound strongbox with the storehouse ledger on its lid. Open it to see everything in every chest around it, search it, and take what you need from whichever chest holds it.
ledgerchest_help: Click: pick it all up   ·   Shift-click: how many   ·   Ctrl-click: all into your bag   ·   Right-click: a stack   ·   Drop things here to put them away
ledgerchest_no_chest_here: No chest around here has room for it.
ledgerchest_take_to_own: Take it into your own inventory: from there you can put it anywhere.
ledgerchest_some_busy: (Some is in a chest someone has open.)
ledgerchest_busy: That is in a chest someone has open.
ledgerchest_back_to_you: No chest has room for {0}: back to you.
ledgerchest_stays: No room anywhere for {0}: it stays in the Ledger Chest.
ledgerchest_stays_msg: No room anywhere: {0} stays in the Ledger Chest
